name: contract-runtime-case-coverage
goal: Verification rejects missing, duplicate, skipped, orphaned or wrong-revision execution of registered cases

evidence: Current case admission checks declarations only. A runner can report no executed registered cases while the declaration registry remains valid. Runtime case outcomes need exact file/title, revision and retry identity.

The existing validate case covers static files, duplicates and orphan declarations but no execution observations. Strengthened that same case for absent, duplicate, skipped, orphaned and stale outcomes while retaining both service cases.

At8339707a33 the existing validate case fails because no executed-case observations produce no validation error. Immutable proof594a5903 preserves the two-case suite and exact missing-execution assertion.

Execution observations now validate exact file/title, nonnegative retry, revision, final passing outcome and declared scope. Focused unchanged suites pass four tests. Normal runner wiring remains a separate integration requirement.

Unchanged two-case suite fails at6668a1271e and passes at57f9da6ec2; paired immutable checkpoints retained with identical command and runtime profile. Registry validation proof only; actual runner integration still pending.
